title: PolyPeptide Group
summary: Swiss contract manufacturer focused on therapeutic peptides.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

PolyPeptide makes peptides for pharmaceutical and biotech customers, with capacity in Europe, the US and India. It benefits from the shift toward peptide-based metabolic and endocrine drugs, where manufacturing know-how is scarce. Capacity utilisation and customer concentration drive results.

Technology Exposure

  • Peptide contract manufacturing
  • Generic peptide APIs
  • Clinical and commercial supply

What To Watch

  • Utilisation of new capacity
  • GLP-1 demand
  • Pricing pressure

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
